info.name: FreightZeb API
info.description:
Complete API collection for FreightZeb logistics platform.

## Setup
1. Start backend: `npm run dev` (port 5000)
2. Start ML service: `uvicorn main:app` (port 8000)
3. Run **01 - Register (ADMIN)** first, then **02 - Login**
4. The `token` variable auto-saves after login â€” all auth requests use it automatically

## Roles
- **ADMIN** â†’ full access
- **WAREHOUSE** â†’ create shipments, bookings, view own data
- **DEALER** â†’ create trucks, view bookings assigned to them

## Testing Flow
1. Auth â†’ Register â†’ Login (saves token)
2. Trucks â†’ Create Truck
3. Shipments â†’ Create Shipment
4. Bookings â†’ Create Booking (use IDs from steps 2 & 3)
5. Bookings â†’ Update Status (APPROVED â†’ IN_TRANSIT â†’ DELIVERED)
6. Tracking â†’ Push Location
7. ML â†’ all predictions
8. Analytics â†’ view dashboard data

request.description: Register an ADMIN user. Token auto-saved to collection variable.

exec: // Try Admin@1234 first, if fails try Admin@5678 (from previous password change run)
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ email: 'admin@FreightZeb.in', password: 'Admin@5678' }) }
// Password was changed in a previous run — reset it back to Admin@1234
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ currentPassword: 'Admin@5678', newPassword: 'Admin@1234' }) }

request.description: Login. JWT token is auto-saved to {{token}} variable.

exec: // Re-login with new password to refresh token
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ email: 'admin@FreightZeb.in', password: 'Admin@5678' }) }
pm.test('Re-login skipped (password may not have changed)', () => true);
if (id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('truckId', id); pm.test('truckId saved: ' + id, () => true); }
